title: Red Queen
author: Victoria Aveyard
summary: In a world divided by blood colour, Mare is a poor Red who unexpectedly shows powers reserved for the silver-blooded elite. The royals hide her at court as a long-lost noble while she secretly helps a rebellion.
readIf: you like YA fantasy with palace intrigue, twists and an anti-hero heroine.
skipIf: you dislike love triangles or want a fresh take on a chosen girl.

pairings.reason: A similar story of a poor girl pushed into the spotlight in an unjust, brutal system.
Another YA about rebellion and survival in a harsh empire with two alternating narrators.
A YA fantasy with a dangerous heroine at a royal court.
